title: kactivitymanagerd does not handle DB corruption properly
line: When the activity database is damaged, Plasma now restores it from its backup at login instead of failing to save favourites and recent files.
explanation: kactivitymanagerd only fell back to its working backup when the resources database could not be opened at all. A database that opens but has damaged pages was used as is: every query on it failed, which hits a Q_ASSERT_X (abort) on builds without QT_NO_DEBUG and otherwise silently drops new favourites, recent files and scores, at every login, while the healthy backup is never used. At startup the daemon now runs PRAGMA quick_check on a read-only connection; a corrupted database is moved to database.corrupt and replaced with the working backup (or a new empty database if the backup is missing or also damaged). The assert in Utils::exec is removed, since failed queries are already handled.

commits.message:
sqlite: Recover from a corrupted resources database

A corrupted database made every query fail, which aborts on debug builds
and otherwise keeps failing forever, losing favourites and recent files.
Check the database at startup and replace a broken one with the backup.

BUG: 389441

media.caption: Master, after restarting kactivitymanagerd and plasmashell: Info Center is gone, the same corrupt database is opened again
Fixed, after restarting kactivitymanagerd and plasmashell: Info Center is still a favourite, errors.log stays empty

review.text: Addresses the real gap: a database that opens but is corrupt was never replaced by the healthy backup. A read-only PRAGMA quick_check at startup, moving the corrupt files aside and reusing the existing backup logic is small and fits the existing initDatabase flow; regressions (healthy DB with WAL, no backup, corrupt backup) were checked. Removing the Q_ASSERT_X is justified since the failure is already handled by reportError, though maintainers may want that as a separate commit.
